title: Layne's Revel Hourly Salez
description: Credentials and report settings for the Layne's Revel Hourly Sales report.

url.title: Revel Hourly Sales URL
url.description: URL of the Revel Hourly Sales report.

username.title: Revel username
username.description: Username used to sign into Revel.

password.title: Revel password
password.description: Password used to sign into Revel.

override_flag.title: Override dates
override_flag.description: When enabled, the Actor uses override_startDate and override_endDate. When disabled, both dates default to yesterday in US Central Time.

override_startDate.title: Override start date
override_startDate.description: Report start date in MM/DD/YYYY format. Used only when override_flag is true.

override_endDate.title: Override end date
override_endDate.description: Report end date in MM/DD/YYYY format. Used only when override_flag is true.

startTime.title: Start time
startTime.description: Report start time in HH:MM 12-hour format.

startMeridiem.title: Start AM/PM
startMeridiem.description: AM or PM for the report start time.

endTime.title: End time
endTime.description: Report end time in HH:MM 12-hour format.

endMeridiem.title: End AM/PM
endMeridiem.description: AM or PM for the report end time.

reportView.title: Report view
reportView.description: Aggregation interval selected in the report's view dropdown.

inclusions.title: Inclusions
inclusions.description: Inclusion checkboxes to tick in the Filters panel. Every inclusion left out of this list is unticked.

supabaseTable.title: Supabase table
supabaseTable.description: Table that receives the interval rows. Leave empty to skip the Supabase upsert. Requires the SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY environment variable.
